subject: english
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

They fired her because she was careless.

options.text: She is being fired by them because she was careless.
She is fired by them because she was careless.
She had been fired by them because she was careless.
She was fired by them because she was careless.

solution:
The correct answer is: **She was fired by them because she was careless.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active form and we need to change it to the passive form.
 
• The given sentence is written in the simple past tense.
 
• The simple past tense in the active voice has the following structure: Subject + V2+ object__
 
• The simple past tense in the passive voice has the following structure: __Object+ was/were V3+ by + subject__
 
• Example - 
 
 
• Active voice - Piyush bought a bicycle.
 
• Passive voice - A bicycle was bought by Piyush.
 
 
 
• Rules of Conversion from Active to Passive Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle form.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct Passive Voice: *She was fired by them because she was careless.*
